meta.homeTitle: Screenshot (App) Maker — Mee App Store Screenshots n'ụzọ dị mfe
meta.homeDescription: Mkpụta App Store screenshots mara mma nke adịla njikere maka nnosonye, jiri Ollama mepụta ụdị ndị egharịrị asụsụ n'ụzọ dị mfe.
meta.ollamaDescription: Jikọrọ Screenshot (App) Maker na Ollama server gị maka ngharịrị asụsụ screenshot nke AI na nzuzo.
meta.privacyDescription: Mụta otú Screenshot (App) Maker si echebe screenshot, nhazi, na usoro ngharịrị asụsụ gị ka ha bụrụ nzuzo.

language.title: Họrọ asụsụ
language.hint: Họrọ asụsụ kachasị mfe n'ebe gị. Aha ngwaahịa na ntuziaka tekniki agaghị agbanwe.

hero.eyebrow: Emeere ya maka etapa ikpeazụ tupu mmepụta
hero.titleHtml: Gbanwee ọnụ ụzọ app gị ka ha bụrụ screenshot ndị dị njikere maka nnyefe.
hero.description: Họrọ wdịbe screenshot ọ bụla nke nnyefe app gị chọrọ, mebiea jikọọ Ollama iji mepụta ụdị localization—n'enweghị mkpa ịme onye ọzọ n'aka.
hero.primaryAction: Hụ otú ọ si arụ ọrụ

features.titleHtml:
Kpochaa oge ị na-akwadebe.
Wepụta ihe gị n'obi ike.
features.description: Screenshot (App) Maker na-eme ka ọrụ ndị a na-ime ugboro ugboro n'ikpeazụ nke mwepụta app ghọọ otu usoro ọrụ doro anya, nke a pụrụ ịhụ.

cards.title: Tinye ndebe-ihe (screens) nke app gị.
cards.body: Weta screenshot-s, tinye ha n'usoro igwe mara mma, ma hapụ akụkọ App Store zuru oke n'ime nke okunye.

cards.title: Design otu ugboro.
cards.body: Hapụ agba, usoro (layouts), ntughari igwe, ụdị mkpụrụedemede, na onyinya n'ebe niile, ma na-eme ka ozi ọ bụla dị iche.

cards.title: Ruo screen ọ bụla.
cards.body: Kwadere ihe ndị a chọrọ maka iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, na feature graphics site n'otu project.

cards.title: Wepụta ngwamba dị njikere maka nyefe.
cards.body: Mepụta foto ndị nwere resolution dị elu, hagebe faịlụ ndị a sụgharịrị, ma kpọkọta metadata App Store gị nke a sụgharịrị n'otu archive dị ọcha.
